title: Salem at the zoo and where-is-it pictures
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Friends of nature; Layla in the snow; Salem at the zoo
source: Written for arabic/y4 lesson 4 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Salem at the zoo and where-is-it pictures)
intro: Lesson 4: Reading: Salem at the zoo; in, on, under. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
ذَهَبَ سَالِمٌ إِلَى حَدِيقَةِ الحَيَوَانَاتِ.
رَأَى الأَسَدَ فِي القَفَصِ.
القِرْدُ عَلَى الشَّجَرَةِ.
السُّلَحْفَاةُ تَحْتَ الصَّخْرَةِ.
قَالَ سَالِمٌ: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ!

box.title: Write a sentence for each picture with فِي، عَلَى or تَحْتَ

questions.q: Where-is-it task on the pupil PDF: three pictures (a cat in a box, a bird on a branch, a ball under a chair). Write a sentence for each, then answer three أَيْنَ؟ questions on the text.
questions.a: القِطَّةُ فِي الصُّنْدُوقِ، العُصْفُورُ عَلَى الغُصْنِ، الكُرَةُ تَحْتَ الكُرْسِيِّ; text answers

questions.q: Extend: why did Salem say سُبْحَانَ اللهِ?
questions.a: He was amazed by Allah's creation.

questions.q: Stretch: write where your pen is now.

questions.a: A) تَحْتَ الصَّخْرَةِ. السُّلَحْفَاةُ تَحْتَ الصَّخْرَةِ.

questions.q: Think again: where is your animal?
questions.a: Pupils' own sentence with فِي / عَلَى / تَحْتَ
